# uptimekuma_notification_rocketchat (Resource)

RocketChat notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_rocketchat" "example" {
  name        = "RocketChat Notifications"
  webhook_url = "https://rocket.example.com/hooks/uid/token"
  channel     = "general"
  icon_emoji  = ":bell:"
  is_default  = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_rocketchat" "with_button" {
  name        = "RocketChat with Button"
  webhook_url = "https://rocket.example.com/hooks/uid/token"
  username    = "Uptime Kuma"
  icon_emoji  = ":warning:"
  channel     = "alerts"
  button      = "View Status"
  is_default  = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: webhook_url_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change webhook_url_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_rocketchat" "write_only" {
  name = "Rocket.Chat with a write-only secret"

  webhook_url_wo         = "https://rocket.example.com/hooks/uid/token"
  webhook_url_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `button` (String) Button text to include in notifications
- `channel` (String) Channel name to send notifications to
- `icon_emoji` (String) Icon emoji to display in RocketChat
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `username` (String) Username to display in RocketChat
- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) RocketChat webhook URL. Stored in state; use `webhook_url_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `webhook_url_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Rocket.Chat incoming webhook URL, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `webhook_url`; requires `webhook_url_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `webhook_url_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `webhook_url` until the next apply with `webhook_url_wo` set removes it from state.
- `webhook_url_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `webhook_url_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `webhook_url_wo`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
